a: Isolation levels trade consistency vs concurrency (e.g. read committed, serializable).
Deadlocks happen when transactions wait on each other; one is aborted.
In PostgreSQL, VACUUM reclaims space and updates statistics.
Sharding splits data across servers by a key.
Replication copies data to other nodes for availability and scale.
CAP: under partition, choose consistency or availability.
Eventual consistency means replicas converge given enough time.
Prepared statements separate SQL from data and reduce injection risk.
A view is a stored query presented as a virtual table.
Materialized views store query results for faster reads.
